state:
Goal `core-ratelimit-and-3-more`. `Core\RateLimit::consume` and `::shed` have all their feature proofs, so the `Core\RateLimit` group owes nothing but a fresh perf figure whenever `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ratelimit.rs` moves again (`bun nv proofs --record-perf --only '<feature>'`).
`Core\RateLimit\Decision::allowed` has all its proofs. Every one of the four `Decision` readers is covered from both sides now: `tests/conformance/core/ratelimit-decision-readers-agree-with-the-sweep.nvst` and the Rust test `the_four_readers_answer_the_decisions_own_slots` carry all four `covers:` markers. An instance member owes no `about.md`.
No shared store is reachable from an example, an attack or a bench, so every `Decision` there is built through `shed`. `shed`'s recorded figure is 10 allocations per call; nothing in the goal asks for less.
`Core\Reflect` and `Core\Reflect\AttributeInfo` are untouched: `Core\Reflect` still sits in `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`.

next.title: the dossier
next.note: one file set: the proof trees under `core/RateLimit-Decision/` (examples, hostile, benches), built through `shed` as `allowed`'s are.

items.text: **`Core\RateLimit\Decision::limit`** — owes examples, hostile, perf; its tests are covered. Three examples, one attack, one bench with `// bench: allocations 0`, since it returns a `uint`. `docs/examples/core/RateLimit-Decision/allowed/` is the shape. `rule:core-classes/ratelimit-gcra`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ratelimit.rs:328`

**`Core\RateLimit\Decision::remaining`** — owes examples, hostile, perf. `remaining` counts after the arrival was charged and is `0` when refused. `rule:core-classes/ratelimit-gcra`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ratelimit.rs:337`

**`Core\RateLimit\Decision::retryAfter`** — owes examples, hostile, perf. The exact wait is just under the drain interval, so an example rounds it up with `toMilliseconds() % 1000` the way `docs/examples/core/RateLimit/shed/03-protect-a-slow-page.nvs` does. It returns a `Duration`, so its bench declares no allocation count. `rule:core-classes/ratelimit-gcra`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ratelimit.rs:346`
**Record the three benches** with `bun nv proofs --record-perf --only '<feature>'` once the last Rust edit of the session is in. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ratelimit.rs:314`

backlog: Subscripting an array with a bare `uint` expression costs two allocations per access, and `as int` costs none (measured on `benches/members/core/RateLimit/shed.nvs`: 12 against 10). A latency finding for the codegen of `[]`; not checked where the allocation happens.

`Core\Reflect::typeOf` and `Core\Reflect\AttributeInfo::field`: class cards (remove both from `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs`), examples, attacks, benches, Rust `covers:` markers — `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/reflect.rs`.
